(I)--the तामसी Kala1 of Hari. Followers of सात्वत तन्त्र designate him सङ्कर्षण. He bears the Earth on one of his

hoods. From between his agitated brows came out Rudra exhibiting in eleven forms. The नाग princes make obeisance to him for his blessings. He wears the वैजयन्ती garland. His glory is sung by नारद and Tumburu in the court of the Creator. Also known as शेष.
